summary: This bill rescinds increased appropriations for Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) and restores Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program (SNAP) benefits to their previous levels by repealing specific sections of Public Law 119-21.

scores.thoughts: The bill explicitly repeals increased appropriations for immigration and customs enforcement (ICE) and rescinds unobligated balances, which directly reduces government spending. It also restores SNAP benefits, which would increase spending compared to the prior reduction, but the primary and most explicit action related to spending is the rescission of ICE funds.

The bill directly reverses a harmful reduction in Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program (SNAP) benefits, thereby restoring and expanding the social safety net for food assistance. This is a central component of the bill.
